images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person view from a conductor's podium looking out over a dark, velvet-red concert hall stage in a wide semicircle: strings front-left, woodwinds center, brass back-right, timpani at the rear under dim organ pipes. Musicians are warm-rimlit black silhouettes under a single tungsten spotlight with drifting dust; deep oxblood curtains frame the sides, heavy vignette and film grain. Over each section float three minimal readable cue glyphs: a pale-blue dashed breathing ring whose size shows timing drift, an amber tilted bow line showing drift speed, and a coral curved stroke showing dynamics. A gold aiming ring circles the brass section, and glowing golden baton afterimage arcs sweep from the podium to the sections. Foreground: a cream score strip on the music stand with past beats marked as small colored notes, and a row of nine dark lacquered gesture cards. Elegant Didone and Korean serif typography, gold on black. Korean UI text: "종악장 「스물넷의 박」", "소리 없음", "당긴다". Silent, tense, intimate mood.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down view of a wooden desk in warm morning window light, soft diagonal window-frame shadows falling across it. A cream hand-ruled music score sheet, slightly rotated, with last night's performance marked in faint ink notes and red pencil curves. Taped on top: a cut-out grey newspaper review clipping with visible halftone print dots, bold Korean serif headline, a halftone photo of a conductor seen from behind, and three short critic remarks, one highlighted in pale red. A red double-ring grade stamp overlaps the clipping edge. To the right, a navy-bound lined notebook with handwritten notes in pencil and red ink carrying the critique into the next concert, and a dark season panel below showing nine nightly score bars (red failures, grey, one glowing gold) with a dashed pass line. A coffee cup at the bottom corner. Paper textures, subtle grain, calm relieved mood. Korean UI text: "만종일보", "고르게 다듬어진 한 시간", "호평 71". Text constraints: show no year or calendar date anywhere; the newspaper dateline reads only "공연 다음 날 아침"; the notebook heading reads "다음 공연을 위해"; critic remarks are attributed only as "평론가 A", "평론가 B", "평론가 C".
